answer: Each identity locks 50 credits in the grove registry for the nebula draft. Each epoch the board drafts each identity for one duty, auditing a canyon archive log signable only by its own key on time. A missed duty burns the bond; re-entry doubles to 100. The k-th fake locks 50 plus 20 labor; past ten duties at once, each extra duty needs a hired hand at 30, so its marginal cost rises past 70. One thousand fakes cost 50,000 plus 20,000 labor. A rented duty ring fails: duties embed their own logs, and a lent key lets the hand seize the bond. An honest identity pays 50 once.
